prompt: My hedges are at 7 DTE. Roll them. I have 2x SPY May-15 $590 PUT and 2x QQQ May-15 $525 PUT.

assertions.text: YAML contains net_debit_estimate field with numeric value
Execution Summary table contains 4 legs: 2 SELL TO CLOSE (SPY May-15 $590 + QQQ May-15 $525) and 2 BUY TO OPEN (new expiry, new strikes)
New expiry selection explained (likely Jun-19 or similar June monthly)
New strikes are within 10-20% OTM of current spot per framework
Current Hedge State section has DTE/residual/P&L table per existing position
Roll Strategy Rationale explicitly addresses: why this expiry, why these strikes, why NOT a collar, why NOT SQQQ
Sizing & Cost Verification section has framework checklist with ✅/⚠️ markers
Risk Notes covers IV, leg-risk, assignment risk, tax treatment of closes
Execution Checklist has bid/ask verification items and hard-stop net debit
